title: IELTS Academic Writing Task 1: Pie Chart on Household Expenditure
prompt: The pie chart below shows the percentage breakdown of average monthly household expenditure in a city in 2023. Summarize the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant. Write at least 150 words. Do not give your opinion or suggest reasons for the spending patterns.
instructions: 本题为模拟练习，所有场景与数据均为虚构，并非官方雅思试卷。请用英语作答，至少150词。先观察饼图各扇区占比，找出最大与最小类别，再比较相近类别之间的差异。注意使用百分比表达和比较结构，不要加入个人观点或原因分析。
